tagline: Accelerating the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics
hero_kpi_rationale: Oncology is the most dynamic and strategic therapeutic segment in pharmaceutical development, representing a growing share of clinical trials and a primary growth driver for CROs like Medpace.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company through its clinical services.
kpis.description: Net revenue increased by 20% in 2025, driven by Oncology, Metabolic, and Central Nervous System.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth in key therapies

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by net revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin stands at 21.1% in 2025 (534.9M / 2530.2M), remaining stable despite investments in headcount.

kpis.name: R&D Expenses (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in research and development relative to revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses are negligible as Medpace is a clinical service provider, not a drug developer. The company does not incur significant internal R&D.
kpis.signal: Marginal R&D investments due to service-oriented model

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Spending to acquire or improve equipment, buildings, or technology.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures amounted to $31.4 million in 2025, or 1.24% of revenue, compared to 1.73% in 2024 and $36.5M in 2024, reflecting improved capex efficiency.
kpis.signal: Capex declining as a percentage of revenue (1.24% vs 1.73%)

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: The company has increased its headcount to support rising service activities, particularly in priority therapeutic areas (Oncology, Metabolic, CNS).
kpis.signal: Rapid team expansion to match growth in trials

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reached $713.2 million in 2025, up 17.1% from 2024, supported by strong clinical service activity.
kpis.signal: Strong cash generation despite share repurchases

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR company facts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $2.53B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR company facts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.451B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Oncology Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in revenue from oncology clinical trials.
kpis.description: Oncology activity increased significantly in 2025, driven by rising demand for clinical trials of new anticancer treatments. This is the therapeutic segment with the strongest momentum.
kpis.signal: Oncology is the primary growth driver

kpis.name: Metabolic Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in revenue related to metabolic disease trials.
kpis.description: Metabolic diseases contributed significantly to growth in 2025, with innovative programs underway in diabetes and obesity.
kpis.signal: High-growth segment driven by diabetes and obesity

risks.title: Customer contract dependency and cancellations
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A source highlights that Medpace is highly dependent on customer contracts that can be canceled with short notice (30 days), representing a significant risk to the predictability and stability of future revenues.

risks.title: Revenue recognition risks
risks.score_rationale: The revenue recognition method based on contract progress and performance obligations introduces complexity. Estimates regarding physical progress and payment terms may lead to uncertainties.

risks.title: Increased competition in the CRO sector
risks.score_rationale: The CRO sector is inherently competitive. Although Medpace is one of the global leaders by revenue, its leading position implies constant exposure to competition from other major CROs.

risks.title: Global operations and regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The source states that Medpace operates in multiple countries (with laboratories and facilities across North America, Europe, Asia, South America, Africa, and Australia). This global footprint requires compliance with various local and international regulations.

risks.title: Stock price volatility and share repurchases
risks.score_rationale: The source indicates that Medpace conducted significant common stock repurchases in 2025 ($860.4M in cash used in financing activities). These substantial repurchases may affect capital structure and shareholder value.

risks.title: Dependence on qualified workforce
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A source notes that 'Direct service costs' include personnel costs (a $43.4M increase in 2025) and that the ability to attract and retain qualified employees is critical for clinical services.

ai_positioning.summary: Medpace (MEDP) does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report for fiscal year 2025. The information provided focuses on financials, clinical operations, governance, and therapeutic growth strategies, with no explicit reference to AI or its applications.
